newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen higher as dollar boosts bonds.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen higher as dollar boosts bonds.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open higher, after a sharp rally sent the dollar surging against European currencies overnight.

"The strength in the U.S. dollar is encouraging and Treasuries are up," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co. "Also, shoppers are still looking for bargains in the small stock sector."

The 30-year U.S. Treasury rose 12/32 to yield 6.33 percent, propelled higher by the dollar's gains. The December S&P 500 index future gained 3/4 of a point to 758.75, indicating a five to 10 point Dow rise at the open.
